chart_model_resolution.finding: The earlier report that C-35 was a shared-framework defect was withdrawn.
chart_model_resolution.cause: subject-profile.yaml lacked depictions.chart_model. The framework already provides depictions.chart_model: none (yyeni_checks.py:581-583, CHANGELOG CR-006; used by the 0460, 9702 and 9618 profiles); without it c35 defaults to break_even and treats the word graph or chart in a prompt as a break-even chart.
chart_model_resolution.fix: depictions.chart_model: none added to the Biology profile on 2026-10-19 at the operator instruction to implement the review; no check weakened, no business fields invented, no graph demand hidden.
chart_model_resolution.note: Graphs and micrographs remain image assets held under visuals_pending; C-35 now checks only items that declare context.chart. Use the project .venv interpreter: system python3 has no PyYAML, so the checker then runs with no profile.
